facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, but foreign currency must be surrendered to an approved bank.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Only with Finance Minister authorisation after a BCEAO opinion.
facts.P3_local_gateways: No local gateway's sign-up requirements were found.
facts.L1_registration: Set up an individual enterprise at a CEFORE one-stop shop, usually in 48–72 hours.
facts.L2_tax_id: IFU (Identifiant Financier Unique), issued through CEFORE.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Under FCFA 15m turnover, a fixed annual micro-enterprise contribution (CME) covers all taxes.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 18% VAT; exported services are exempt; small taxpayers don't charge VAT.
facts.L5_data_protection: Law 001-2021: declare personal data processing to the CIL beforehand.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Service buyers can withdraw within 7 working days.
facts.L7_incentives: Low fixed CME tax, and a 2-year business-licence exemption for RSI businesses.
facts.D1_id_document: National ID card (CNIB), being replaced by the AES biometric card.

watch_out.text: All foreign-currency income from abroad must be surrendered to an approved bank.
